battle.name: 黃巢南下福州之戰
battle.brief: 乾符五年（878年）八月，黃巢攻宣州不克，被宣歙觀察使王凝擊敗於南陵，遂引眾入浙東，開山路七百里直插閩北，攻剽福建諸州；十二月甲戌陷福州，福建觀察使韋岫棄城走。卡面的羅馬標槍並未隨義軍入華，它代表的是以重投槍破盾的技術路線，唐軍這裡靠的是長矛、弓弩與攻城器。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場戰爭的交戰方是兩支互不隸屬的聯軍。義軍一方是流寇式的軍事集團：沒有兵部，沒有國庫，基層編制以「隊」「夥」為單位，步卒佔絕對多數，騎兵比例不高，糧食靠沿途徵取與掠奪就地解決。乾符五年二月，曾元裕在申州東大破王仙芝、殺一萬人、招降散遣萬人，其後在黃梅追斬仙芝，殺五萬餘人；仙芝既死，尚讓率其餘眾歸黃巢，巢正攻亳州未下，遂被推為王，號沖天大將軍，改元王霸，自署官屬，這支部伍由是從數股流寇整合成一路可以指揮的隊伍。唐廷一方沒有統一指揮系統：宣歙觀察使王凝守宣州、福建觀察使韋岫守福州、鎮海節度使裴璩守浙西、荊南節度使高駢先在荊南後調鎮海，各道兵將互不屬於，兵資糧餉各出自本鎮，朝廷只有詔書與空名告身來勉勵各道出兵。中央財政同時枯竭：連歲旱蝗，耕桑半廢，租賦不足，內藏虛竭，朝廷甚至要向商旅富人借貸錢穀、出賣殿中侍御史與監察御史的空白告身來湊軍費。真正守在城上的，多是各縣臨時募來的鄉兵與土團，例如杭州以諸縣鄉兵各千人編為「杭州八都」，董昌為其長。還有一層中間地帶：王仙芝餘黨曹師雄在宣、潤、湖、浙西二浙流竄，與黃巢一前一後把東南攪成一片互相牽制的混亂，這正是義軍得以穿行其間的縫隙。
countriesEn: The two sides in this war were two coalitions that belonged to no one. The insurgents were a bandit-style military group: no ministry of war, no treasury, the base unit a dui or huo of foot soldiers with only a small proportion of cavalry, and food taken from the country as they marched, consumed on the spot. In the second month of the fifth year of Qianfeng, Zeng Yuanyu broke Wang Xianzhi east of Shanzhou, killing ten thousand men and scattering another ten thousand in surrender, and later ran him down at Huangmei, killing more than fifty thousand. With Xianzhi dead, Shang Rang brought the survivors to Huang Chao, who at that moment was still pressing the siege of Bozhou, and the men made him their king: he took the style Great General Who Charges to Heaven, changed the era to Wangba, and appointed his own officers. A group of separate bands was thereby welded into one force that could take orders. On the court side there was no unified command at all. The commissioner of Xuan and She, Wang Ning, held Xuanzhou; the circuit commissioner of Fujian, Wei Xiu, held Fuzhou; the circuit governor of Zhenhai, Pei Hu, held western Zhejiang; and the circuit governor of Jingnan, Gao Pian, moved from Jingnan to Zhenhai. Troops and commanders belonged to no one but themselves, each circuit paid and fed its own men, and the court could only urge them into the field with edicts and certificates bearing empty titles. Central finance had dried up at the same time: drought and locusts year upon year, half the fields abandoned, rents insufficient, the treasury exhausted, so that the court had to borrow money and grain from wealthy merchants and peddle blank certificates of the posts of Palace Attendant and Censor to scrape together military funds. Those actually holding the walls were largely freshly recruited village militia and local levies; Hangzhou raised a thousand men from each county and organised them into the Eight Banners of Hangzhou, with Dong Chang at their head. There was also an intermediate layer: the remnants of Wang Xianzhi under Cao Shixiong roamed through Xuan, Run, Hu and the two Zhejiang circuits, and stirred the southeast into a chaos in which they and Huang Chao distracted one another. That was the seam through which the insurgents passed.
people: 留下姓名的多在兩端，中間那批人幾乎無名。黃巢是曹州冤句人，鹽幫出身，早年販私鹽，屢試進士不第；乾符五年二月曾元裕奏「大破王仙芝於黃梅，殺五萬餘人」，仙芝被斬傳首之時，巢正攻亳州未下，尚讓帥仙芝餘眾歸之，推巢為王，號沖天大將軍，改元王霸，署官屬，此後由江西虔、吉、饒、信一路打到閩浙。曾元裕是這一年朝廷的招討使，申州東之戰殺一萬人、招降散遣萬人，追斬王仙芝的就是他。宣歙觀察使王凝是本戰役守方最關鍵的人物，他以據城與地形之利在南陵擊退黃巢，迫使義軍放棄宣州、轉入浙東。福建觀察使韋岫是另一端的代表，乾符五年十二月甲戌福州陷落時棄城而走，此後閩中再無朝廷能穩住的高官。鎮海節度使裴璩在浙西擊破曹師雄於湖州，又曾以招降王郢黨人朱實、散其徒六七千人、收器械二十餘萬而知名。乾符六年正月，鎮海節度使高駢遣將張璘、梁纘分道追擊黃巢，屢破之，迫其降將數十人，巢於是趨廣南；高駢隨後奏以郴州守險、循潮邀遮、大庾嶺趣廣州的三路部署，封住義軍北歸與東竄之路。浙東方面，杭州刺史董昌與石鏡都知兵馬使錢鏐以「杭州八都」起家；建州人陳巖後以九龍軍據閩中，擊敗泉州叛將李連而自代福建觀察使；王潮其後據泉州、克福州，開閩國之基。
peopleEn: The names that survive sit at the two ends of this business, and the men in the middle are almost all nameless. Huang Chao was a native of Yuanjue in Caozhou, a salt-band man who had sold salt outside the monopoly and had failed the metropolitan examination more than once. In the second month of the fifth year of Qianfeng Zeng Yuanyu reported that he had broken Wang Xianzhi at Huangmei and killed more than fifty thousand; while Xianzhi was being beheaded and his head sent forward, Chao was still pressing the siege of Bozhou, and Shang Rang brought Xianzhi's survivors to him. They made him king: he took the style Great General Who Charges to Heaven, changed the era to Wangba, and set up his own officers. From there he fought his way through Qian, Ji, Rao and Xin in Jiangxi and on into the Min and Zhe circuits. Zeng Yuanyu was the court's commissioner for suppression that year: ten thousand killed and ten thousand surrendered at Shanzhou, and it was he who ran Xianzhi down. The most important defender in this campaign was Wang Ning, commissioner of Xuan and She, who beat Huang Chao back at Nanling by holding his city and using the ground, and so forced the insurgents to give up Xuanzhou and turn into eastern Zhejiang. Wei Xiu, circuit commissioner of Fujian, stands at the other end: when Fuzhou fell on the jiaxu day of the twelfth month of the fifth year of Qianfeng he abandoned the city and fled, and after that the court had no official in Fujian it could keep in place. Pei Hu, circuit governor of Zhenhai, broke Cao Shixiong in Hu prefecture in western Zhejiang, and was known earlier for taking in Zhu Shi of Wang Ying's party, scattering six or seven thousand men and capturing more than two hundred thousand weapons and implements. In the first month of the sixth year of Qianfeng, Gao Pian, now governor of Zhenhai, sent Zhang Lin and Liang Zuan to chase Huang Chao in two columns, defeated him repeatedly, and forced the surrender of several tens of his commanders, whereupon Chao turned south toward Guangnan. Gao Pian then proposed the deployment of holding the passes at Chenzhou, interdicting the routes of Xun and Chao, and pushing over the Dayu Ridge with a force of his own, and thereby sealed off the insurgents' road north and east. In eastern Zhejiang, the governor of Hangzhou, Dong Chang, and the commander of the Shijing guard, Qian Liu, rose out of the Eight Banners of Hangzhou; Chen Yan of Jianzhou later gathered the Nine Dragon Army in the Min, defeated the rebel Li Lian of Quanzhou and took the post of circuit commissioner for himself; and Wang Chao afterwards took Quanzhou and Fuzhou and laid the foundation of the state of Min.
kits: 卡面上這件羅馬標槍，不可能出現在乾符五年的閩浙山中，它是公元前二世紀羅馬軍的裝備：半米長的投槍，槍幹中空，外裹軟木再加鐵箍，既可插在地上作障礙，也可擲出破盾；捅穿盾面之後槍杆即折，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。把它放進本戰役的裝備表，是因為它標示出一條與唐軍完全不同的技術路線。唐軍步卒的骨幹是長柄器與刀：直刃長矛用來壓迫與刺穿，陌刀雙手劈砍，環首刀便於拔出，戟則多配於有正式軍籍的部隊；遠射以弓為主，弩有臂弩與拉力更大的蹶張弩，配箭袋與機括，是守城與攻城時的常備。甲胄方面，官軍以皮甲、札甲為主，金屬鎧甲數量有限，義軍多無甲或僅粗布纏身，靠盾與拒馬木倚仗。攻城與守城的器材包括雲梯、撞車、投石用的砲、穴地用木版與鍬、火箭與火油。運輸靠馬、驢、牛與徵自州縣的車馬，閩浙山道狹窄，牛車多改為人背擔，糧食則就地取給於被掠的州縣。與標槍功能最接近的，是仍以雙手擲出的短投槍與弩的重箭；但唐廷著錄的器械中不見中空軟木桿加鐵箍的同型槍。唐軍攻城靠的是長矛壓制、弓弩覆蓋與攻城器破門，義軍攻福州主要靠雲梯、撞木、火攻突門，而不是以投擲兵器消耗守軍。羅馬用重投槍破盾，唐用弩箭與長矛，這正說明武器技術從來不是單線傳播的。
kitsEn: The Roman pilum on the card could not have been present in the mountains of Min and Zhe in the fifth year of Qianfeng. It was the equipment of the Roman army of the second century before the present: a throwing spear half a metre long, its shaft hollow, sheathed in soft wood and bound with iron rings, so that it could be planted in the ground as a barrier or thrown to punch through a shield. Once it had gone through a shield the shaft snapped, and the man on the other side could only drag himself back behind cover with half a spear still in his hand. It belongs in the equipment table of this campaign because it marks out a line of technical development entirely different from the Tang army's. The backbone of the Tang foot soldier was the pole weapon and the blade: the straight-bladed mao for pressing and thrusting, the modao wielded two-handed for chopping, the ring-pommel straight sword that could be drawn without twisting, and the ji, which went largely to troops on the regular rolls. Missile weapons were chiefly the bow, with crossbows of the shoulder type and of much greater draw, carried with quivers and triggers and standard for both the assault and the defence of walls. For armour, the government troops relied on leather and on lamellar protection, metal harness being scarce; the insurgents for the most part had none, or only coarse cloth wound round the body, and depended on shields and on wooden abatis. The tools of siege and defence included scaling ladders, battering rams, stone-throwers, planks and spades for driving tunnels, and fire arrows and fire oil. Movement depended on horses, mules and oxen and on wagons taken from the counties they overran; the mountain tracks of Min and Zhe are narrow, so ox carts were often replaced by men carrying loads, and food was taken on the spot from the counties they plundered. The closest functional relatives of the pilum are the short throwing spear still pitched by hand and the heavy bolt of a crossbow; yet among the arms recorded for the Tang there is nothing matching the hollow soft-wood shaft bound with iron. The Tang attacked walls by pressing with the spear, saturating with arrows from crossbows, and breaking the gate with siege engines, and the insurgents who took Fuzhou relied on ladders, rams and fire at the gate rather than on thrown weapons to wear down the defenders. Rome broke shields with the heavy pilum; the Tang used the crossbow bolt and the spear. That is precisely the point: weapon technology has never travelled along a single line.
tactics: 義軍的戰術可以歸成四個字：流動、避實、掠食、不守。乾符五年三月，黃巢度江攻陷虔、吉、饒、信等州，別將曹師雄掠宣、潤，王重隱陷洪州，五月之後轉向宣州。八月攻宣州不克，被宣歙觀察使王凝在南陵擊退，義軍隨即捨宣州而入浙東，並在山間開出七百里的新路，繞開正面關隘與沿線的官軍據點，直插閩北。這條路是這場戰役的關鍵：唐廷的防禦建立在幾條大道與幾座城上，義軍卻把防守方最依賴的地形變成自己的通道，一支大軍因此得以從浙東整建制地進入福建。攻福州時義軍並未長期圍城，而是利用守軍的空虛與崩潰，福建觀察使韋岫棄城而走，城遂陷；破城之後義軍掃掠州縣、劫掠市舶貨、驅取人口，卻不屯駐，繼續沿海岸與山道流動，先後掃過泉州、漳州一線。官軍方面的應對仍舊是分道自保：裴璩遣兵擊破曹師雄於湖州，杭州以諸縣鄉兵各千人編為八都以守土，荊南之敗的教訓是「羅城既陷，將佐共守子城」，各城因此把資源集中在內城與城門；高駢接手鎮海之後不與義軍正面對撞，而是據險邀擊，遣張璘將兵五千於郴州守險、王重任將兵八千於循、潮二州邀遮、自將萬人趨大庾嶺，斷其北歸與東竄之路。義軍終究沒有在閩北站住腳，這一課在兩年後的長安再上一次：能攻而不能守，正是流寇式軍隊的天花板。
tacticsEn: The tactics of the insurgents can be reduced to four words: movement, avoiding the strong, living off the country, and not holding. In the third month of the fifth year of Qianfeng Huang Chao crossed the river and took Qian, Ji, Rao and Xin, the separate commander Cao Shixiong raided Xuan and Run, and Wang Chongyin seized Hongzhou; after the fifth month the force turned towards Xuanzhou. In the eighth month the attack on Xuanzhou failed, Wang Ning of the Xuan and She circuit beat him back at Nanling, and the insurgents promptly gave up Xuanzhou, turned into eastern Zhejiang, and cut a new road of seven hundred li through the mountains, skirting the passes on the direct routes and the posts the government held along the line, driving straight into northern Fujian. That road is the key to this campaign. The court's defence rested on a few great roads and a few walled cities; the insurgents turned the ground on which the defence depended into their own corridor, and so a large army was able to enter Fujian from eastern Zhejiang with its organisation intact. When they took Fuzhou they did not lay a long siege: they took advantage of a garrison that was hollow and breaking, the circuit commissioner Wei Xiu abandoned the city, and the city fell. After the capture they swept the prefectures and counties, took the goods of the maritime trade, and drove off people, yet they did not garrison, and went on moving along the coast and the mountain tracks, through Quanzhou and the Zhangzhou line. The court's response remained provincial self-preservation. Pei Hu sent troops that broke Cao Shixiong in Hu prefecture; Hangzhou raised a thousand men from each county and formed the Eight Banners to hold its own ground; and the lesson of Jingnan, where the outer city had fallen and the officers then held the inner city together, taught every city to concentrate on its inner ward and its gates. Gao Pian, once he had Zhenhai, did not try to meet the insurgents in the open; he held the passes and intercepted them, sending Zhang Lin with five thousand to hold the passes at Chenzhou, Wang Zhongren with eight thousand to interdict the routes of Xun and Chao, and taking ten thousand of his own over the Dayu Ridge, so as to cut off the road north and the flight east. In the end the insurgents did not hold in northern Fujian, and that lesson was taught again two years later at Chang'an: the ability to take cities without the ability to keep them is the ceiling of an army of this kind.
data: 可核對的數字分幾類。年月最為確定：乾符五年三月，曾元裕在申州東大破王仙芝，殺一萬人、招降散遣者一萬人；其後在黃梅追斬仙芝，殺五萬餘人；同年八月黃巢寇宣州、敗於南陵、轉入浙東；十二月甲戌陷福州；乾符六年正月高駢遣張璘、梁纘追擊，巢趨廣南。路程與距離：開山路七百里，按唐里折算約三百五十公里，把浙東與閩北山區連成一條可供大軍通行的路；自宣州南陵到福州直線約五百五十公里，自福州到廣州約六百五十公里。兵力：義軍南行時自報十餘萬，至廣明元年進洛陽時眾達百萬，兩年之間膨脹近十倍；杭州以諸縣鄉兵各千人編成八都，合計約八千人；高駢的追擊部署是張璘五千、王重任八千、高駢自將萬人，合計兩萬餘，他後來另募土客之兵共七萬。損失與消耗：江陵城下舊三十萬戶，至是死者什三四；嶺南大疫，黃巢軍死者十三四；泉州海商被劫約萬人，這類數字必須打折看。財政：連歲旱蝗，耕桑半廢，租賦不足，內藏虛竭，朝廷只能向商旅富人借貸錢穀，並出賣殿中侍御史告身五通、監察御史告身十通，能湊出的名額極有限。
dataEn: The numbers that can be checked fall into several classes. The dates are the firmest: in the third month of the fifth year of Qianfeng Zeng Yuanyu broke Wang Xianzhi east of Shanzhou, killing ten thousand men and scattering ten thousand in surrender; he later ran Xianzhi down at Huangmei and killed more than fifty thousand; in the eighth month of the same year Huang Chao attacked Xuanzhou, was beaten back at Nanling and turned into eastern Zhejiang; in the twelfth month, on the jiaxu day, Fuzhou fell; and in the first month of the sixth year of Qianfeng Gao Pian sent Zhang Lin and Liang Zuan after him, and Chao turned south toward Guangnan. Distances and routes: the seven hundred li of new road, which by the Tang reckoning comes to roughly three hundred and fifty kilometres, joined eastern Zhejiang with the mountains of northern Fujian into a line a large army could use; the straight line from Nanling in Xuanzhou to Fuzhou is about five hundred and fifty kilometres, and from Fuzhou to Guangzhou about six hundred and fifty. Strength: the insurgents claimed a hundred thousand and some when they moved south, and by the time they entered Luoyang in the first year of Guangming their numbers were said to be a million, a growth of nearly ten times in two years; Hangzhou raised a thousand men from each county into the Eight Banners, about eight thousand men in all; Gao Pian's pursuing force was five thousand under Zhang Lin, eight thousand under Wang Zhongren and ten thousand under himself, some twenty thousand in all, and he later raised a further seventy thousand of local and immigrant soldiers. Losses and consumption: the old thirty thousand households beneath Jiangling saw one in three or four of their number die; an epidemic in Lingnan killed one in three or four of Huang Chao's men; and about ten thousand maritime merchants were plundered in Quanzhou, a figure that has to be discounted. On finance: with drought and locusts year upon year, half the fields abandoned, rents insufficient and the treasury empty, the court could only borrow money and grain from wealthy merchants and sell five blank certificates of Palace Attendant and ten of Censor, a very small number of titles to distribute.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最表層是朝廷自己製造的：乾符四年冬，荊南節度使楊知溫不設備，仙芝得以度漢水、陷江陵羅城；其後朝廷以招降為名，楊復光遣人說諭王仙芝，仙芝遣尚君長等請降，平盧節度使宋威卻遣兵在道中劫取君長等，斬於狗脊嶺；招降不成，王仙芝被曾元裕追殺於黃梅，餘眾無路可走，尚讓遂帥之歸黃巢——這是把可以解散的叛軍變成可以建國的軍隊的關鍵一步。中間層是結構性的：唐末節度使掌兵掌財，朝廷號令不出四方，州縣兵少、承平既久不習戰、遇盜多敗；財政空竭到要靠出賣空名告身籌軍費，遇上連歲旱蝗、耕桑半廢，亂軍自然有兵源，也有吃糧的辦法。底層是空間的：義軍要活下去，就必須找守軍的縫隙。宣州有王凝據城死守，攻之不下；浙西有曹師雄的仙芝餘黨在流竄，裴璩雖擊破之於湖州，兩浙仍無可恃之兵；福建一端幾乎是空的——觀察使韋岫所部不足以守城，城陷時他棄城而走，而市舶之利、沿海之富又足以引誘大軍停留取糧。黃巢開山路七百里轉入閩北，正是因為他要在朝廷最薄的地方通過，而要通過，先得自己開路。
causeEn: The reasons for the outbreak lie in three layers. The outermost was manufactured by the court itself. In the winter of the fourth year of Qianfeng, Yang Zhiwen, circuit governor of Jingnan, made no preparations, and Xianzhi was able to cross the Han and take the outer city of Jiangling. Then the court made overtures to surrender: Yang Fuguang sent men to reason with Wang Xianzhi, Xianzhi sent Shang Junzhang and others to ask for terms, and Song Wei, governor of Pinglu, sent soldiers to seize them on the road and had them beheaded at the Gouge Ridge. The surrender failed, Xianzhi was hunted down and killed at Huangmei by Zeng Yuanyu, and the survivors had nowhere to go, so Shang Rang brought them to Huang Chao. That single step turned a band that could have been dissolved into an army capable of founding a state. The middle layer is structural. In the late Tang the circuit governors held the troops and the revenue, the court's orders no longer reached the four quarters, the counties had few soldiers, long years of peace had left them unpractised, and they usually lost when they met bandits; finance was so empty that military funds had to be raised by selling blank certificates, and with drought, locusts and half the farmland abandoned there was both a supply of recruits and a way to feed them. The deepest layer is geographical. The insurgents had to live, and living meant finding the gaps in the defence. Xuanzhou was held by Wang Ning and could not be taken; in western Zhejiang Cao Shixiong's remnants of Xianzhi's army were on the move, and although Pei Hu broke them in Hu prefecture there was still no reliable force in the two Zhejiang circuits; and the Fujian end was very nearly empty, the circuit commissioner Wei Xiu's troops insufficient to hold the city, so that when it fell he abandoned it. The wealth of the maritime trade and the rich coast were enough to hold the attention of a large army. Huang Chao's seven hundred li of new road into northern Fujian was the answer to all this: he had to pass where the court was thinnest, and to pass there he first had to open the way himself.
impact: 這場戰役的影響集中在東南。第一，福建的官府秩序斷裂：福州失守、觀察使棄城之後，建州人陳巖以九龍軍聚眾數千保鄉里，擊敗泉州叛將李連而自代福建觀察使，閩人安之；朝廷任命的觀察使被地方武裝取代，這一格局在往後十數年裡一直維持，直到王潮據泉州、克福州，閩國的雛形由此成形。第二，浙江的武裝化加速：杭州以募來的鄉兵土團守土，編為杭州八都，董昌、錢鏐由此起家；而曹師雄寇二浙造成的地方真空，正是義軍得以長驅入閩的條件。第三，朝廷層面，為追討義軍而倚重淮南兵，鎮海節度使高駢的兵權坐大，其部將張璘在乾符六年前後屢破義軍、渡江降王重霸、攻克饒州，追奔黃巢而至廣明元年戰死；追討一場叛亂，反把另一個藩鎮推上歷史前台。第四，對黃巢本人，這一仗是身份的轉折：他有條件佔領一個對外通商的大港，取得市舶之貨與嶺南的財賦，才有本錢在兩年之後集眾百萬、渡淮入洛陽。第五，從武器史看，羅馬標槍那條以重投槍破盾、破盾即棄的路線，自始自終沒有在中國落地；唐廷的答案是弩箭、長矛與攻城器，不同地區各自找到自己的解法，這一點在這場戰役裡看得最清楚。
impactEn: The consequences of this campaign fell mainly on the southeast. First, the administrative order in Fujian broke: after Fuzhou was lost and the circuit commissioner fled, Chen Yan of Jianzhou gathered several thousand men in the Nine Dragon Army to hold his own village country, defeated the rebel Li Lian of Quanzhou and took the post of circuit commissioner for himself, and the people of Min were content with him. A locally raised armed group had replaced an officer appointed by the court, and this arrangement held for more than a decade afterwards, until Wang Chao took Quanzhou and Fuzhou and the beginnings of the state of Min were laid. Second, the militarisation of Zhejiang accelerated: Hangzhou defended its own ground with recruited village levies organised as the Eight Banners, and out of this Dong Chang and Qian Liu made their careers, while the local vacuum left by Cao Shixiong's raiding of the two Zhejiang circuits was exactly the condition that let the insurgents march into Fujian. Third, at the level of the court, the pursuit of the insurgents relied on the armies of Huai-nan, and the military authority of Gao Pian as governor of Zhenhai grew accordingly; his commander Zhang Lin broke the insurgents repeatedly around the sixth year of Qianfeng, crossed the river and took Wang Chongba over, stormed Raozhou, pursued Huang Chao and was killed in the first year of Guangming. In chasing one rebellion the court pushed another military governor onto the stage of history. Fourth, for Huang Chao himself the campaign was a change of status: he had gained the chance to seize a large port open to foreign trade, and to take the goods of the maritime trade and the wealth of Lingnan, which is what gave him the means two years later to gather a hundred thousand men, cross the Huai and enter Luoyang. Fifth, in the history of weapons, the Roman line of the heavy pilum that breaks a shield and is then thrown away never took root in China at all; the Tang answer was the crossbow bolt, the spear and siege engines, and different regions found their own solutions. That is the plainest lesson this campaign has to give.
result: 乾符五年十二月甲戌，福州陷落，福建觀察使韋岫棄城走，黃巢大軍攻剽福建諸州，沿海一線的州縣與市舶商旅首當其衝；但義軍沒有在閩北設防，也沒有把福州變成據點。乾符六年正月，鎮海節度使高駢遣張璘、梁纘分道出擊，屢破義軍，迫使黃巢降將數十人，遂趨廣南；四月高駢再奏以郴州守險、循潮邀遮、大庾嶺趨廣州的三路部署，把閩浙北面的通道封死。乾符六年九月，黃巢取得率府率告身，怒而攻廣州，一日而下，執節度使李迢，轉掠嶺南州縣；其後嶺南大疫，十餘萬眾死傷過半，黃巢反以劫掠所得與嶺南資源為養，廣明元年冬眾至百萬，渡淮、陷洛陽、年底入長安。就這場戰爭本身而言，結果是明確的：唐廷沒有守住福州，卻用一年時間把黃巢從閩浙趕回嶺南，再把他趕上北去的路；而福州陷落所打開的缺口，讓黃巢第一次拿到了足以支撐百萬眾的財源與海路。也正因如此，這場戰役在唐末亂局中的位置，不只是兩軍在福建的一場會戰，而是一次戰略轉向：義軍由江淮轉入閩粵，又由閩粵轉回中原，福建只是這條大迂迴上的一站。
resultEn: On the jiaxu day of the twelfth month of the fifth year of Qianfeng Fuzhou fell, the circuit commissioner Wei Xiu abandoned the city, and Huang Chao's army went through the prefectures of Fujian, with the coastal districts and the maritime merchants bearing the first of the blow. But the insurgents did not dig in north of Fujian, and did not make Fuzhou a base. In the first month of the sixth year of Qianfeng, Gao Pian, governor of Zhenhai, sent Zhang Lin and Liang Zuan out in two columns, defeated the insurgents repeatedly and forced the surrender of several tens of Huang Chao's commanders, so that Chao turned south toward Guangnan. In the fourth month Gao Pian proposed again the three-part deployment of holding the passes at Chenzhou, interdicting the routes of Xun and Chao, and pushing over the Dayu Ridge, and the northern approaches out of Min and Zhe were sealed. In the ninth month of the sixth year of Qianfeng, Huang Chao received the certificate of the rank of military prefect, flew into a rage, attacked Guangzhou and took it in a single day, seizing the circuit governor Li Tiao and ranging over the prefectures of Lingnan; then an epidemic in Lingnan killed more than half of a hundred thousand men, and Huang Chao lived on what he had plundered and on the resources of Lingnan, so that in the winter of the first year of Guangming he had a hundred thousand men, crossed the Huai, took Luoyang and entered Chang'an before the year ended. As to the outcome of this war itself, it is clear enough: the court did not hold Fuzhou, but in the space of a year it drove Huang Chao back from Min and Zhe to Lingnan and then on to the road north; and the breach opened by the fall of Fuzhou gave Huang Chao, for the first time, the resources and the sea route by which a hundred thousand men could be kept. That is why the place of this campaign in the disorder of the late Tang is not that of a single engagement in Fujian between two armies, but of a strategic turning: the insurgents passed from the Huai and the Yangtze into Min and Guangdong, and from Min and Guangdong back to the Central Plain. Fujian was only one station on that long detour.
